title: Vegan Roasted Wrap
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make vegan wrap filled with roasted vegetables and vibrant spices.

ingredients.name: Kielbasa
ingredients.notes: use vegan kielbasa or omit for a kielbasa-free version

ingredients.name: Roasted Vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, zucchini, and onions

instructions: Toss the roasted vegetables with olive oil, vibrant spices, and salt. Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes.
Warm the wrap in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
Spread the vegan hummus on the wrap.
Add the roasted vegetables, kielbasa, lettuce, tomato, and pickled red onion.
Drizzle with vegan mayo and garnish with fresh cilantro.
Note: For the pickled red onion, slice 1/2 cup red onion and soak in 2 tbsp vinegar for 10-15 minutes.
Note: Adjust the amount of kielbasa to your liking or omit for a kielbasa-free version.
